meaning:
συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: 2Ti.2:3; with dative commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, 2Ti.2:18.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: e thou partaker of the afflictions

elsewhere.note: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
